notes: Offline registry of license-checked dependencies (fonts first) shared across projects. Mirrors image_generation.providers in tools.default.json: each entry records its license_reference + an embedding_allowed / commercial_use_verified pair, and clearance is an offline, evidence-recorded act (never a live network license check). The `dependency select` CLI verb clears a chosen dependency AT SELECTION TIME (design/pre-production), shifting the license check left of the artifact that embeds it. A font is `cleared` only when embedding_allowed AND commercial_use_verified are both true; otherwise it yields a `pending`/`restricted` rights record that BLOCKS the rights gate, exactly like an unverified image provider. Font family names referenced by .claude/config/design_policy.json MUST exist here (analogous to trim keys existing in print_pdf.TRIM_SIZES). Overridable by an optional .claude/config/dependencies.local.json (deep-merged). font_file_path values point at .ttf files bundled under .claude/config/fonts/ and were confirmed to report the recorded `family` via Pillow ImageFont.truetype(...).getname(). Variable [wght] files load in Pillow with the Regular default instance, which is what the compositor draws captions with.

fonts.notes: SIL Andika is a sans-serif face purpose-designed for literacy and beginning readers: clear, rounded, unambiguous letterforms (single-storey a, distinct I/l/1). Fits the early-reader-6-8 'clear, rounded, high-legibility' brief. Fully embeddable + commercial under OFL 1.1. RFN 'Andika, SIL' — restricts only modified derivatives, not unmodified embedding. Static Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic bundled. Pillow getname() -> ('Andika','Regular').

High-legibility face engineered to disambiguate similar characters for low-vision readers. No Reserved Font Name. True static (non-variable) TTFs bundled — Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic. Embeddable + commercial under OFL 1.1. Pillow getname() -> ('Atkinson Hyperlegible','Regular').

2025 successor to Atkinson Hyperlegible: 7 weights, 150+ languages. No Reserved Font Name. Bundled as a single [wght] variable file whose default instance is Regular — loads directly in Pillow for single-weight caption rendering. Embeddable + commercial under OFL 1.1. Pillow getname() -> ('Atkinson Hyperlegible Next','Regular').

fonts.source: SIL Global — https://software.sil.org/charis/ (v7.000 release, renamed from 'Charis SIL')
fonts.notes: Bitstream-Charter-derived serif workhorse for long reading passages; SIL v7.000 (family renamed 'Charis' from 'Charis SIL'). Full static Regular/Bold/Italic/BoldItalic. RFN 'Charis, SIL' — restricts only modified derivatives. Embeddable + commercial under OFL 1.1. Pillow getname() -> ('Charis','Regular').

Warmer, more calligraphic old-style serif alternative to Charis; good for diacritic-heavy multilingual text. Full static weight set. RFN 'Gentium, SIL' — restricts only modified derivatives. Embeddable + commercial under OFL 1.1. Pillow getname() -> ('Gentium Plus','Regular').

fonts.source: Google Fonts / Storm Type Foundry — https://github.com/googlefonts/literata
fonts.notes: Purpose-built ebook/long-form serif (commissioned for Google Play Books); warmer, contemporary trade-book feel for adult nonfiction. Pre-built static instances bundled (use plain 'Literata-Regular.ttf'; the Literata_18pt/24pt/... optical-size statics report suffixed family names). RFN 'Literata'. Pillow getname() -> ('Literata','Regular').

Reading-fluency face designed from reading-speed research (a research-backed general-fluency peer to Atkinson's glyph-disambiguation approach for accessibility). No Reserved Font Name. Full static weight range 100-900. Embeddable + commercial under OFL 1.1. Pillow getname() -> ('Lexend','Regular').

Grotesque display face; the bundled file is the Black weight (font_file_path -> Archivo-Black.ttf) for chapter headers / running heads — a plainer, less-juvenile alternative to a rounded display face for adult titles. Apache-2.0: no Reserved Font Name mechanism, simplest license to reason about, with an explicit patent grant. NOTE: Pillow getname() reports family 'Archivo' with style 'Black' (the family field records the shared family; the Black weight is the bundled style).
